body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: ef57929b717faf27592affa89dcbf2406503e161 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #990** (this is stacked on #990; I reviewed only the last commit, ef57929b, plus the trial merge with current main). Posted-G-code change: a Hub run is still owed, see notes.

**What looks good**
- G96 is capped at the workholding max in both lathe dialects without touching a post script: `setup_workholding::css_of` (crates/app/src/setup_workholding.rs) folds min(tool, workholding) into `Css.max_rpm`, hooked at crates/app/src/posting.rs:906; the posts then take min(machine, tool, workholding). Fanuc posts `G50 S<cap>` before `G96` (fanuc-lathe.cps:389), Tormach posts `G96 D<cap>`. Pinned by `a_2000_rpm_chuck_clamps_g96_under_a_higher_tool_and_machine_in_both_dialects` (`G50 S2000 / G96 S170`, `G96 D2000 S170`).
- G97 over the limit is refused by name at the program gate (`program_problems`, wired into `verification_report` posting.rs:647), naming op, rpm, setup and limit; the post is blocked ("post blocked ..."), never capped. At-limit is allowed; undo re-refuses. Both dialects only exist as two lathe posts (fanuc-lathe, tormach-lathe), and the G97 gate is dialect-independent, so no lathe dialect is uncovered.
- Command: validated at creation (finite, 1..100000, no-op, not-a-setup), undoable `invert` restores previous value; MCP tool and project key are additive and corrupt values are refused naming the setup; `datum_from` keeps the rating; no unwrap/panic in the new code; provenance lines present; decision file added.

**Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, clean merge)**
| run | result |
|---|---|
| lathe_workholding_rpm / mcp_workholding | 5 / 1 pass |
| lathe_post_css, lathe_post, lathe_post_tormach, lathe_post_refusals, tormach_lathes | 10 / 7 / 7 / 6 / 2 pass |
| posting, setups, commands_undo, project_roundtrip, cutting_data | 17 / 12 / 30 / 71 / 6 pass |
| golden_cl, solid_law_goldens | 25 / 1 pass |
| camcraft-app --lib | 114 pass |
| camcraft-ui --lib (crates/ui) | 533 pass, 5 ignored |
| clippy app+ui --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Goldens: this commit moves none (`facing_css.nc` etc. come from #990 below it). No snapshot PNGs, no build.rs/.github/scripts/deps, no process files, no PROCESS_VERSION need.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Hub run owed: this changes posted G96 clamp words when a limit is stated (nothing changes for setups without one). Please run a lathe setup with a 2000 rpm chuck through the Hub sim and read the `G50 S` / `G96 D` and the G97 refusal.
2. The UI row (Workholding max rpm on Settings) needs the maintainer's hand check; structural assertions pass.
3. Merge order: #990 first, retarget this to main before it merges (the PR says so).
4. G97 judgement only covers ops where the spindle law says the work turns; live-tool/mill ops on a lathe are intentionally outside the chuck limit. Fine, just confirming that is intended.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
